Clangd compile flags and warning settings for C and C++ source files.

# Purpose
This file defines compile flags for source files and applies them by file pattern. It sets preprocessor macros that enable platform and feature options such as `_XOPEN_SOURCE`, `FD_HAS_ALLOCA`, `FD_HAS_ATOMIC`, `FD_HAS_DOUBLE`, `FD_HAS_INT128`, `FD_HAS_ZSTD`, `FD_HAS_SSE`, and `FD_USING_CLANG`. It also assigns language standards for header, C, and C++ files with `-xc-header`, `-std=c17`, and `-std=c++17`, and it enables warning checks such as `-Wall`, `-Wextra`, `-Wpedantic`, `-Wstrict-aliasing=2`, `-Wconversion`, `-Wdouble-promotion`, `-Wformat-security`, and `-Wimplicit-fallthrough` for C and C++ sources.
